name: Structure attended to before more is built on it
purpose: A planted structural problem is raised and routed to the right party, a clean structure stays silent, an unchanged digest, a run at its ceiling and a switched-off watch make no call, a repeated item is raised again only when worse, and the caps hold.
record: Eighteen scripted cases (evaluation/structure_watch/build_cases.py) with a fixed model reply and no network: five planted problems (an experiment past its reevaluation with work piling on what it holds fixed, three implementations and no metric, a duplicate added by recent work, a milestone past its date that planned work depends on, an investigation past refresh that planned work relies on), three clean structures, no call for an unchanged digest, a repeat and a worse repeat, the caps on a large structure and an over-long reply, both routes of an item (applied and recorded for AI-made unreviewed structure; a proposal for a person's, a running experiment's or an irreversible one), a run at its ceiling and the setting off. One number: the share of cases whose last step shows exactly what is expected.
disadvantages: Written by one author with a fixed reply, so it measures the plumbing, the rules and the routing and not whether a real best-tier reply is wise; the real call is a single later case.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rival were recorded on the same cases] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=one real best-tier call over the hub's own records is read by hand and its tokens are counted]
command: esoi run structure_watch --impl best_tier_call; esoi run structure_watch --impl findings_only
